nom: Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+

avis.texte: Here's a polished version with a title: My Go-To for a Glowy Makeup Look I absolutely love this product. The bottle lasts a long time, and I even bought another one on sale just to restock for when I run out. It makes my makeup look super glowy and honestly works perfectly as a prime. I don't even use a separate primer anymore!

Right out of the bottle, this is thin and runny. It felt like I was putting chalk on my face, and it looked like I had done just that. I even tried rubbing and rubbing it in. thinking I would eventually look less white. but no. Would not recommend.

I've used other Avene products and enjoyed them, so I was excited to try this one out when my normal sunscreen was sold out. I'm pretty pale and don't mind a white cast, but this one was just awful. It's also incredibly thick and difficult to rub in. The only reason I didn't return it is because I hate unnecessary waste
I think its good i got it because its clean .. and based on Yuka it does not have have harsh chemicals

avis.titre: Immediately buying another one once i finish my bottle
avis.texte: Skin tone is kept toned even & surprisingly doesn't dry my face. Glowy not oily. One of the best parts is no white cast left behind. I use it as part of my daily skin care routine now. Also part of my makeup prep routine. I am looking forward to see how nice & smooth my skin can get even more.

avis.titre: No white cast - on Casper the ghost
avis.texte: Holy smokes…i love avene and had high hopes for this mienral sunscreen as it says "little to no white cast". Perfect since I fluoresce under moonlight, and if i time it right i can be seen from the ISS during a full moon. If you look at a nighttime satelitte image, im the speck just north of tampa bay. I thought "little white cast will be like the perfect foundation" but whoa was i not expecting what i got. It was like putting runny white playdough on my face. That just got sticky when rubbed in. Like i said i wanted to love it as i use avene chemical sunscreen. But its gonna be a no from me dawg.
The price is so high for such a small amount of the product.Nothing Special though.

This sunscreen is the best mineral sunscreen I have used. The formula changed slightly from the previous version. People who have noticed that this is watery and separated need to make sure they shake the product. It needs to be shaken VIGOROUSLY. It still sounded like water was sloshing around until I had been shaking it for about 15 MINUTES. It is worth it though. It is still a FLUID, so it will be very liquidy. I noticed that if I rub it with my hands and then put it on my face, it thickens up. I think that it dries down pretty well, but I'm a little oilier with this version than the one previously. It still is the best I have tried compared to other brands of a similar price point. One major flaw was the change in the bottle opening. They used to have a "dropper" like opening but changed it to a pin-hole opening. Since my bottle was sitting unused for a bit, some product got built up at the opening. At first, I was able to get it open by using a pin, but that was annoying having to use that each time. Then I tried a toothpick; it actually pulled out the pin-hole shaped plug and then I was able to clean out the built-up product. I was able to replace that pin-hole plug and then it worked perfectly fine. At least I know that I can fix it again if it has that build up happening again. In terms of the white cast, I don't notice anything, but then I am really pale with a reddish hue on parts of my face so that could be why. I still greatly recommend this product for anyone who

Do not recommend. Loved it at first, but separated and became a watery mess after just 2 months. Would not recommend or purchase again. Very disappointed. This was a miss, even though love other avene products I've tried.
This sunscreen is a great product! Amazing coverage. The texture is not oily as most sunscreens are. The sent is soft and subtle. Great ingredients.

I never use to protect my skin with sunscreen, but as I'm getting older I know just how important it is to wear sunscreen. This Avene sunscreen is a winner! It doesn't sit heavy on the skin and wears well under makeup. It's very light but also very protective. It does not leave a white cast on your skin. My skin is very sensitive and this sunscreen does not bother my face at all. Great brand!!
I'm always looking for a good natural sunscreen without harmful chemicals. This is a good option that goes on pretty clear and spread. It did feel a little heavy under my makeup though.
I absolutely love this sunscreen! It doesn't leave a greasy feeling and it gives my skin a really nice glow. There is a scent but it's super subtle.

I stopped using American sunscreens many years ago in favor of Japanese/Korean formulations, as so many American products felt greasy, heavy, and gross. I had a chance to try this sunscreen from Avene and decided to go for it since so much has changed in sunscreen formulation in recent years. Yet this still was greasy, heavy, and gross. Everything I hate about Western sunscreens, with the additional bonus of a heavy white cast. That last bit is noteworthy because I'm pretty fair, just above an NC10, and this washed me out horribly. I couldn't even bring myself to keep it on for a day because it felt like I had a mask on my face. Major fail, and I will probably just use this up on my arms and legs.

avis.titre: easy to apply, meets the description
avis.texte: Packaging, color, smell, and texture are excellent. I really liked this sunscreen. It is easy to apply, leaves no residue, and the ingredients are good for the skin. They protect my skin from damage. It is long-lasting, and I can carry it with me. It comes in a small bottle. I am really satisfied.

I didn't have a good experience using this sunscreen. It left me with white casting and didn't blend into my skin very well. I do like that it's a mineral sunscreen and it has multi-defense properties. I can still benefit by using this sunscreen on my body in the summertime.

So sad about this new formula and they decreased the size of the bottle from 1.7 ounces to 1.3…. I loved the old forumla and wasnt happy about the size change but was willing to pay it cause I love the product. I bought one bottle it was fine, the second bottle I was going to purchase was watery, cant even put it on my skin. And then went to the store and they were all extremely watery. Im unfortunately going to have to find a new product.

So I love Aveene products but I'm still trying this one out. It goes on with a white cast, but once rubbed in it's invisible. The only issue I've been having is I can feel it on my skin. I'm trying to wear it all day without taking it off to see if it still bothers me, this could just be a me thing. But it's like a dry film. It also smells... not like sunscreen, but clay? If that makes sense. I know it'll protect my face, but again I don't know if I can get over the feeling or the smell. We shall see.
Cute bottle and the texture is soft. It protected my skin really well and doesn't have a fragrance which is nice because my face is sensitive. Worth the buy!

avis.titre: Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50+ for sensitive Face Skin
avis.texte: I have been using the Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+ for over a month now. First: I like how invisible this sunscreen is! There is no grayish, bluish or white cast after applying! I added pictures of my and my son skin, my skin is fair and his is tan (makeup tones). Second: There is no typical sunscreen scent, it has a scent but more like a thick cream smells. Third: The Ingredients! There is Niacinamide for even skin, Bisabolol & Allontoin to soothe & calm skin, and also Pro-Vitamin E to protect against environmental oxidative stress. Oxidative Stress in Skin plays a significant role in skin aging and disease, leading to visible signs like wrinkles, fine lines, and pigmentation! Overall the Avène Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+ for sensitive face skin, is a sunscreen that I would definitely get again and also let my son use it! My son's skin is hypersensitive and he gets allergic reactions to a lot of different products, he didn't got a skin reaction with this fluid.
Package was bright and alert to grab attention. Sun protection was very good even though I did still burn lol. texture and scent was average. natural ingredients adds lots of benefits

avis.titre: Just not good enough- white cast, doesn't absorb,
avis.texte: Unfortunately, this sheer facial sunscreen has too many negatives. I was sent the "tinted" version to try as well. You'll see some side by side comparisons. The product is very runny and needs a good shake. It claims to be fragrance free and this seems accurate. The directions state to "apply generously" and to my knowledge 1/4 tsp is required for face and neck to achieve the maximum SPF rating listed on the product (50+ for this one). To apply enough for full protection it was very white and didn't seem to absorb. It's heavy and greasy and doesn't dry down which I prefer in a facial sunscreen. I tried to rub it in better hoping it would improve the way it looks, but it just rubbed off on my hands (see in one of my photos.) Even with less product from essentially rubbing off some product it still looks bad. The white cast improves some after drying but I don't think this would work on someone with darker skin. It doesn't work well under makeup either. This one was a let down all around, I have other sunscreens that are way superior. In my opinion, it needs a reformulation as it's just not good.

This is a bit more of a liquid consistency but a little goes a long way so I feel like this is going to last me a while!! You definitely don't want to use too much but if you use just enough you get the coverage without the white cast, even on dark skin and this is what I like about it. The packaging is also sleek so it fits right in a travel essentials bag in a carry on. I will be using this for my day to day use.
I have been enjoying using this sunscreen. It goes on smoothly, without a white cast. I like that it is zinc-based! Will be using all summer long!

I had the opportunity to try the Avene Mineral Sunscreen for over two weeks, and here are my thoughts. It worked well under makeup. I wasn't a fan of the white cast that came from the sunscreen. It took a while to work it into the skin. I was happy that the sunscreen didn't pill. I just wished it absorbed a little better.

I really liked this SPF. It's not greasy and it feels moisturizing at the same time! It doesn't leave a white cast which is great! The scent isn't amazing but it's hard to find a good smelling sunscreen. I'd definitely recommend!
The packaging is beautiful on this product, texture is very light, scent is not too strong, sun protection is perfect! I give it a 10/10, I would recommend to everyone!

avis.titre: No crazy white residue on your face!
avis.texte: Could it be? A mineral sunscreen that doesn't leave being the white cast? It is actually lightweight and sheer! It works and won't make you look like you have white Halloween makeup on! It even works for teens with oily acne prone skin because it isn't crazy thick or make the face feel greasy.

avis.titre: Not creamy but a runny fluid
avis.texte: I tried this Avene mineral sunscreen as I received it as a free sample from Influenster for my honest opinion! I put it on my body first because I am picky about what goes on my face and this is a sunscreen for your face! The first thing I noticed was the scent wasn't pleasant to me and it made me get a headache because it was strong! I am sensitive to smells! It did do the job as far as protection from sunburn! It is liquid like and runs but when rubbed in it doesn't cover much before needing more and then it feels a bit like it may clog my pores! I wouldn't purchase it myself.

I really love this sunscreen. It provides great protection from the sun and it is not greasy. It does not break me out and I love that it is a mineral based sunscreen so no harsh chemicals or chemical smell.

Thanks Avene for the complimentary sunscreen in exchange for my honest review! I'm trying to use less makeup and more skincare and hope this would be a great addition to my morning routine. I liked that it was small because you don't need much, and it's TSA size approved. It's a good product but it leaned yellow undertones, so it didn't quite match my olive skin tone. This would be good for someone with yellow or pink undertones. @influenster #complimentary @aveneusa #aveneusa

I've really been enjoying this Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50! My favorite thing about it is that it's completely fragrance-free — no heavy sunscreen smell, which is a huge plus. It blends into the skin fairly well for a mineral sunscreen, though it does leave a slightly dewy finish. I love that it uses 100% mineral filters (zinc oxide and titanium dioxide) along with Avène's Thermal Spring Water to help soothe and protect sensitive skin. It feels lightweight, gentle, and provides strong SPF 50 protection without irritation. Definitely a great everyday option if you're sensitive to fragrance or chemical sunscreens.

I found the sunscreen easy to apply without any greasy-ness. It hasn't been very sunny or warm where I live for me to accurately see how well the SPF works. It doesn't have an overbearing smell either. I will definitely be using this on my face some summer since I have sensitive skin.

Summer is coming and the most important thing you need before you leave the house is sunscreen. This sunscreen is made just for your face. It is so lightweight and has no scent. It's small, so you can keep it in your bag to reapply throughout the day, and it's water resistant.

The ingredients seem to be only what is needed. The texture is a bit on the thick side so keep that in mind when doing skincare routine. There didn't seem to be much of a scent which is what I liked. The packaging was perfect for on the go.

This is a great mineral sunscreen option! I normally wear a tinted sunscreen to work during the week, but this one is perfect for a no makeup day! Has a bit of a glow, but nothing crazy at all. No scent. Doesn't break me out. Love!

I really liked this sunscreen. It had a great texture that absorbed into the skin very well and didn't leave any white cast or residual feeling. The scent was the typical neutral sunscreen scent but wasn't overwhelming.

I recieved the Avene Sunscreen from Influenster for complimentary testing purposes. I love this little Sunscreen! It is a high SPF in a little package. Small enough to keep in a bag/purse or in your car for just in case. You never know when you'll need it. Also, just in case anyone didn't know.... the SPF number is how often you need to reapply. So a 50 SPF needs to be reapplied ever 50 minutes.
The Avene mineral sunscreen multi defense fluid spf 50+ is a great sunscreen. It goes on very nicely and isn't too greasy. The smell is nice and the ingredients are safe.
I like this sunscreen! I was worried that it may cause me to break out but it didn't! It blends into the skin nicely and did leave me looking or feeling greasy!
Mineral Sunscreen Multi-defense fluid spf 50+ is a wonderful product. It's very effective with a light scent. A creamy texture. It absorbed quickly and is to offer 40 minutes of water resistance.

I loved this sunscreen, even though it is a physical sunscreen, it does not leave that white cast on the skin, it is semi-dry to the touch, there is no increased production of oil, the packaging being small fits everywhere
This is a good sun screen. It doesn't have a strong sun screen smell. It goes on smoothly and feels good on the skin, absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a white cast.
Feels light! I dont know enough about ingredients to say if it's "clean." Protects agains blue light, so good for everyday use. Simple packaging. A slight smell but better than others.

The scent is barely noticeable. The texture threw me off at first. I thought it was going to go on and not rub in smoothly and leave a sticky residue, but it didn't! It's got a nice twist cap which will prevent leakage. I'm not sure about the sun protection because it hasn't been sunny here.

avis.titre: Insufficient sun protection and orange skin color
avis.texte: Bought Avene mineral sunscreen (Blue light option) couple months ago; it does absorb well, but leaves very orange- brown residue on the skin, I don't think it protects my skin, as well as some of the other mineral sunscreens, as when I went skiing and was in the sun from 2-3 hours a day, it did not provide any protection. I would be cautious with this product.
Not my type of sunscreen. Texture is heavy and not so easy to blend. It leave some white cast. Also it feels quite a bit greasy. Packaging was a ok but sometimes it pumps too much.

avis.titre: Lightweight Mineral Sunscreen That Works Under Mak
avis.texte: I've been testing out the Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+, and overall, I really like it—especially for everyday wear, whether on its own or under makeup. It has a lightweight, fluid texture that spreads easily. There is a bit of a white cast at first, but after a few minutes, it settles in. This sunscreen gives a natural matte finish—not too drying, but not greasy either. I love that it layers well under makeup without pilling or making my skin feel heavy. On days when I go makeup-free, it gives just enough of a smooth finish to make my skin look put together. It's fragrance-free and formulated for sensitive skin, which I appreciate.

The package of the Avene sunscreen is pretty plain.. basically has no scent..the texture is smooth and creamy not greezy at all.. effectiveness seems good although I haven't had much warm sunny days it matters that it is spf 50 as I'm very fair skinned @influensters @Avene

Trying out the Avène Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50+ that I got for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest thoughts. I'm really careful about what I put on my skin, and this one's a win for me—good ingredients, no white cast, works great under makeup, and no weird smell. Big yes from me!
Love this sunscreen. Seems very lightweight and not a strong scent. Packaging makes it compact enough to pack in my purse all summer long. Can't wait to use it!
I love mineral spf but the white cast is not it for me. This protects without turning me into a pasty white ghost. I have used it for outdoor activities in the Florida sun and would recommend.

Works well, haven't had any lapses in coverage. It's very watery and so can come out quickly and if you don't have the lid secure, it can leak. It is a mineral sunscreen so you have to work it in otherwise it does have a white cast.

This is a fabulous lightweight 100% mineral sunscreen that provides broad spectrum SPF 50+ with protection against UV rays, pollution, and blue light. It offers 40 minutes of water resistance as well. It's not greasy, and moisturizes the skin so well leaving it with a natural, mattifying finish. It's easy to apply and glides on nicely without leaving a white cast on the skin. It's also fragrance free. I love this sunscreen and highly recommend giving it a try!

avis.titre: A Mineral Sunscreen That Easily Absorbs and Feels
avis.texte: The texture of this mineral sunscreen is divine! Usually mineral sunscreens are incredibly difficult to rub into the skin, but Avene goes on so smoothly and immediately absorbs into the skin leaving zero residue. I can't wait to use this at the beach during spring break!

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin, not sensitive noses.
avis.texte: The sunscreen itself is great for my sensitive facial skin however the smell for me was unbearable. As soon as I got home I had to wash my face. The texture was wonderful. Loved the minimal packaging. Overall it's a great product my daughter loves it since she cannot smell what I smell.

Avene Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+ is a fantastic option for those with sensitive skin. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a greasy residue, making it ideal for everyday use. The broad-spectrum protection (UVA and UVB) is great for shielding skin from both the sun and environmental stressors. Plus, it has a soothing effect. It's a solid choice for those looking for high protection without the heavy feel of traditional sunscreens.

I really like this mineral sunscreen. It's not greasy, absorbs into my skin quickly, doesn't break me out, and doesn't leave a white cast like many other mineral sunscreens do. The scent is also mild, which I appreciated. The only downside is that the consistency of the sunscreen is thin so it drips a bit on my hand when I go to apply it, if I didn't do it quickly. I will definitely be using this sunscreen when I spend more time outside during the summer months.

I got this sample from influencer for free for my honest review. It is kind of a smooth texture. It comes in a small size. The scent is plain. It is good for sun protection and sensitive skin. It is 50+ spf. It has a lot of ingredients. I hope to wear this this summer.

This is scent free, which I appreciate. It blends in quickly. It doesn't leave a white cast on my skin. It isn't oily. The packaging is simple and works well. I am enjoying using this alone or with makeup. I really enjoy the brand. They put carefully studied ingredients in. I absolutely recommend it.

It's a tiny bit heavy and very moisturising. It does not leave any white cast despite being a mineral sunscreen and absorbs very quick despite the thick texture! Love the sunscreen. The packaging is very sturdy as well. Definitely buying it again

I was lucky enough to get to try Avene Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+. I like that it is easy to open and to apply. It goes well under makeup or just by itself. I did not detect a fragrance, which is nice for a facial sunscreen. It seems to have effective ingredients that aren't harmful. I would like for it to ve a bit thicker as it's a little runny, but otherwise, it is a great sunscreen option.

avis.titre: Protected while swimming for 40 minutes and doesn'
avis.texte: This is a mineral sunscreen with an SPF of 50+ ( blue light) and it's safe for daily use. I use this under makeup or alone and it definitely sits well on the skin without a greasy layer or shine. It goes on sheer and lightweight. Lasts while swimming without burning your eyes so that's something we loved about this. Says it lasts for 40 minutes while swimming! I definitely notice that it does a great job at protecting my face in the sun. I am a very pale person with red cheeks so I burn easily in the sun and this saves me from burning. Over all I'll definitely use what I have till it's gone and be buying more!

avis.titre: Light weight and great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I received the Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+ for free in exchange for my honest opinion, and after testing it out, here's my review! ✨ What I Love: ✔ 100% Mineral Protection – Uses zinc oxide for broad-spectrum coverage without chemical filters. ✔ Lightweight & Fluid Texture – Absorbs quickly and doesn't feel heavy. ✔ Great for Sensitive Skin – Formulated with Avène's thermal spring water to soothe and hydrate. ✔ Minimal White Cast – Blends in better than most mineral sunscreens! ✔ Fragrance-Free & Hypoallergenic – Perfect for my sensitive skin. ⚡ Things to Note: ▫ It has a dewy finish, so if you have oily skin, you may want to set it with powder. ▫ Since it's a fluid formula, it needs a good shake before use. ▫ Works well under makeup but might require extra blending. Overall, I'm really impressed with how gentle yet effective this sunscreen is! Would I repurchase? Absolutely!

I received this Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+ for free from Avene and Influenster in exchange for my honest opinion. This is ultra lightweight and easy to spread and blend into the skin. It leaves behind a healthy looking glow and helps soothe irritated skin (perfect for sensitive skin). SPF is a pretty big deal at our house and this being safe for 6 months and up, it's a fantastic option for all of us.

I love this comes in an easy to use squeeze tube. No scent that's noticeable. I love its mineral. It's better than most mineral sunscreens I have used. It blends in pretty quickly into skin and isn't crazy thick or tacky. It gave me great and long protection. I used it in Jamaica for a week and felt like I got several hours of coverage with being active and in and out of the ocean.

No weird smell. Pretty thick, but I like that. Great spf of 50 for sun protection. When you are at the pool you need to make sure to reapply at least every couple hours and always make sure to give it 15 min before exposure to the sun. Love the small bottle to keep in my bag at all times.

Avene's Mineral Sunscreeb Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50 is one of the best sunscreens I've used it's light and non greasy, and doesn't leave my face white. It's very easy to apply as it spreads well on your skin and is absorbed quickly. Also didn't cause a breakout. A bit pricey for a small bottle, but you get what you pay for.

I like that this has no scent and the texture is light and non greasy! It hasn't been too sunny here to know how well it protects from the sun, but i like that it's a mineral sunscreen. This size is perfect to keep in my purse.

avis.titre: Has a slight smell but gives nice coverage
avis.texte: First of all, the packaging is great, easy to open. It applies smoothly, but it has a funky scent. It's not as bad as the tinted version, but I do not like the scent at all. I can even explain how it smells, but it's unpleasant. The product itself works well. Used it alone, has a glow, dewey finish. try it out for yourself
Not a huge fan of the feeling of this but it does go away after a few minutes. It's pretty effective. Light scent. Not out of a budget when it comes to a sunscreen.

Used this on my cruise and my face didn't get burnt at all. Smooth texture, no fragrance, and the ingredients are spot on for a great sunscreen for your face. Package is perfect size to throw in your pocket or beach bag so you can reapply as needed throughout the day.
This product has a very nice feel to it. It's not greasy and it's not heavy. There is no smell. I like that it is a mineral sunscreen. I'll keep using this one.
Great texture for sunscreen product, perfect absorption, no really white cast, easy apply under makeup and on its own makes skin glowy and smooth looking
This is really good and nice for your skin. It has a nicer smell than any of the chemical regular sunscreens. I like it and am happy I got it. The texture is also like a lotion.

avis.titre: Great Quality but White Cast Shows Up on Skin
avis.texte: I've been using the Avene Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid SPF 50+ for a while now, and it has some standout qualities along with a few drawbacks. Pros: ✅ Gentle on Sensitive Skin: This sunscreen is fragrance-free and formulated for sensitive skin, which is a huge plus. I've experienced no irritation, redness, or breakouts, even with regular use. ✅ Lightweight Texture: The fluid consistency makes it easy to spread and blend into the skin without feeling greasy or heavy. ✅ Great for Daily Use: It layers well under makeup and doesn't pill, which makes it a solid choice for everyday wear. ✅ Effective Protection: With SPF 50+, it provides strong protection against UVA/UVB rays and environmental aggressors. Cons: ❗ White Cast: Since it's a mineral sunscreen, there's a noticeable white cast, especially on medium to deeper skin tones. With extra blending, it fades somewhat, but it may still be visible. ❗ Drying on Some Skin Types: While the formula isn't overly mattifying, those with dry skin may find it a bit lacking in hydration. Pairing it with a moisturizer helps. ❗ Price Point: It's on the pricier side compared to some other mineral sunscreens, though the quality and gentle formula may justify the cost for those with sensitive skin.
I've been wearing this for a few weeks now. So far I'm not the biggest fan of using it. It takes some work to blend for me. It doesn't have a foul odor so that's a plus.

avis.titre: Easy to apply but purple tint?
avis.texte: So, starting off with the pros of this sunscreen; it seems to protect my skin pretty well in the sun, the texture of it is very smooth and watery which makes it easy to glide one, and lastly there is no scent so my skin has not been irritated. My one con is how it looks on my skin once applied, i don't get that pasty white look i often get from sunscreens BUT it gives me skin this like purple-ish tint? I've managed to make it less obvious by putting on less each morning but it's kind of frustrating.

avis.titre: Lightweight, gentle sunscreen that protects well w
avis.texte: lightweight, fluid texture that blends easily without leaving a white cast. It offers great sun protection and feels comfortable even on sensitive skin. The fragrance is very minimal, which I appreciate, and the packaging makes it easy to dispense the right amount. Plus, the ingredients are gentle and non-irritating — perfect for my sensitive skin!
Packing is simple. Ingredients are clean. Its sun protection is great. No scent. And the texture is smooth.highly recommend this sun screen especially if you have sensitive skin

avis.titre: A must have in the skincare routine
avis.texte: Sun protection should be worn everyday…I am terrible at doing so in the winter. This on the other hand since I received it has gotten me to wear it everyday. It doesn't feel/smell/look like sunblock. It melts into the skin and feels hydrating. It looks oily just for a couple minutes as you rub it on until it soaks in, then it feels light. Sunscreen or UV protection is very important! This had no smell to it really and doesn't leave my face looking like a ghost.
I thought this product had promise, but unfortunately with continued use I experienced the unfortunate white/purple cast that people with melanin can experience when using white sunscreens.

The Avene Mineral Sunscreen goes on so smooth and sheer. It only takes a very small amount for full coverage. It does not leave behind any greasy feel or oily appearance. Perfect for everyday use. It's water resistant and even protects skin from pollutants and blue lights. The quality is excellent and there's no irritation noted even after daily use. I can't imagine using any other sunscreen on my face now!

Overall I thought this product was nice and effective. A couple things I wasn't a huge fan of was its pretty runny. Initially feels greasy and fine gritty. But once it's on it is light weight and didn't feel greasy or chalky. Wears well throughout the day. No strong sunscreen scent either.

avis.titre: Solid choice for individuals with sensitive skin
avis.texte: The Avene Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense SPF 50 is a solid choice for individuals with sensitive skin who are looking for a mineral-based sunscreen. Its gentle formula, broad-spectrum protection, and relatively lightweight texture make it a favorite for many. However, the potential for a white cast and slight greasiness should be considered, especially for those with darker skin tones or oily skin. Consider purchasing a smaller size or sample to test it out before committing to a full-size bottle, especially if you have concerns about breakouts or white cast.

I've used this brand before and love it! I specifically use this for my face. It is lightweight and not oily. Great sun protection! The bottle is tiny but a last a long time because with this formula a little goes a long way!

This sunscreen is an easy way to protect my skin before applying makeup. It has a runny consistency that quickly absorbs into the skin without leaving a white residue behind. It's non-sticky, lightweight, and doesn't have that overwhelming sunscreen smell that so many have. Because it absorbs quickly, you don't have to worry about pilling when layering with foundation. And since mineral sunscreen doesn't absorb into the pores, I don't have to worry about breakouts or skin irritation.
I really liked this mineral sunscreen and it's protection. It didn't make my skin feel cakey either, which I really liked that. 10/10 would reccomend.

This sunscreen does not leave the skin greasy, it is soft, light, it has a high protection of 50spf, it is water resistant, it is recommended to use every day, even if you do not leave the house and it can also be used by people with sensitive skin! It's perfect!

Game changer!!! This mineral sunscreen was a bit runny right out of the package, but after applying and rubbing it in, the white cast faded within 5 minutes. Any other sunscreen snob will understand how much of a game changer this product is. Does not irritate eyes.

This sunscreen is lightweight and blends easily into my skin without leaving a white cast. It feels soothing and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin, which is a huge plus. I also love that it's water-resistant and gives great sun protection. A must-have for daily use!

Be prepared for summer with this sunscreen. It offers great sun protection with an SPF of 50, is moisturizing, doesn't clog your pores, soaks in quickly, and doesn't leave a white cast. It really doesn't have a smell and seems to be really gentle on even the most sensitive skin.
At first I was like sweet, then I used it. I didn't like the smell and the texture was quite runny. There was also a residue lingering. Left my skin icky

This product has some great ingredients without feeling too heavy. If you apply makeup, you will need to give your skin time to settle after applying and before putting on your makeup. Not a fan of the scent but overall, it's a decent product

I received this item complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I used this today while working out in the yard. It was somewhat sweat proof, but some did sweat off and was not pleasant in the eye. It did keep my skin from too much sun, as is its purpose. I just received this item last week. This makes it hard to give a fully informed review in terms of long lasting skin effects.

avis.titre: Just stopped using after years of only this
avis.texte: I'm a long-time Avène lover, but recently in preparation for potential import tariffs in the U.S., I've been trying to find U.S. brands that are good for sensitive skin. However, this sunscreen (and the one-of-a-kind Avène Cicalfate+) was going to be the one thing I continued using, regardless. Then, they changed the formula slightly and reduced the fluid ounces offered from 1.7 to 1.3, which means I now need to buy two bottles every month to cover my face, back of the neck, throat, chest, and backs of the hands/my forearms if they're going to be uncovered—just once daily. That was upsetting enough. This new formulation also isn't as gentle nor as hydrating as the previous (although just as runny, which I never really cared about), and as someone with Sahara-dry skin that's also hyper sensitive, this no longer is my top choice. I have three bottles left and I intend to finish them, but I won't be repurchasing in the future. Still, due to chronic illness and other skin issues, I don't spend a lot of time out in the sun. For the past (I believe) 9-11 years, this has prevented sunburn. I'm a former Floridian, born and raised, and have lived in Seattle for almost 8 years. (Contrary to what people think, Seattle often feels brighter than the Tampa Bay are of Florida did.) And even with genetics not being on the winning side, I my skin looks younger than most of my peers—even younger women—without surgical, dermatological/laser, or injectable intervention. So, it works! (To note: I

The sunscreen has a liquid texture, like the name implies. It is a typical mineral sunscreen in the sense that it does not blend in all that easily and leaves a white cast. It also just doesn't sink into the skin and stays slightly tacky and very shiny. I don't love a tacky face so this isn't going to become my favorite.

I love when sunscreen goes on sheer. It makes my face feel like I have nothing on. It smells like typical sunscreen, but not overpowering. The size that I received makes it a perfect travel companion!
This is a nice sun defense fluid. The texture is thin and not greasy. It is a mineral sunscreen so doesn't have a great scent. I love how sheer and lightweight it is.
I was very happy to receive this even more because its for sensitive skin so that's is a plus for me very good size to travel love the skin protection ill be getting with my spf 50

Avene Mineral Sunscreen SPF 50 is an excellent product. It provides high protection against UV rays, making it ideal for outdoor activities. The formula is lightweight and non-greasy, perfect for daily use. It helps keep the skin hydrated while offering a matte finish, preventing any oily buildup.

This is a terrific facial sunscreen. It's a mineral sunscreen, which is a plus, and it's SPF 50 which is a must for protecting my face. It is so lightweight and it applies like a dream, even over foundation when I reapply during the day. It's absolutely terrific!

avis.titre: Protect my skin and make it glow!
avis.texte: Great sunscreen that is actually good for your skin. It provides good protection and coverage from harmful rays, a little goes along way. Feel so comfortable on the skin, it sits well for hours on your skin. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly, leaving no greasy or white residue, which is perfect for daily use.

I love the feeling of the sunscreen. It has minimal smell. Very nicely packaged you squeeze a little bit and it actually covers your whole face. No white cast. It feels thick, but not on your skin and spreads very evenly.

avis.titre: Has a white cast and is very runny
avis.texte: The Avène Mineral Sunscreen Multi-Defense Fluid has an SPF of 50+ that protects the skin from UV rays, pollution and blue light. The formula contains niacinamide and pro-vitamin E which helps smooth the skin. The texture is very watery and runs out of the tube. It does absorb fairly quickly into the skin and feels lightweight. It's also water resistant and doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. I experienced a pretty significant white cast on my skin after applying, despite the product's claims that it doesn't. I also wasn't a fan of the scent of this sunscreen. I wouldn't recommend this product if you have a darker skin tone.

This sunscreen is not my favorite. It is extremely watery and starts spilling out when the tube is turned upside down. The application process is messy and quite the hassle. It also feels and looks quite greasy, which i am not a fan of. It does have a nice scent, but there are many other aspects that can be addressed.

It's very important to use SPF on my face and body especially now that I am aging gracefully that is but in all honesty, my dermatologist says that there's really no difference from 35 SPF to 50 but in regardless, this doesn't smell bad and it is light weight as they say I'm just glad that there's no color in this. I guess I'm just not thrilled for an SPF that has some type of color in it. But I would definitely recommend trying this out and it does tell you to reapply it every 40 minutes so with that being said would I buy this probably not because you can get a bigger SPF that does just as good and that will last longer.

This sunscreen was easy to apply and lives up to its lightweight name. It rubs in well with minimal white cast. Hard to tell cause I'm kinda pale. It's not heavy or sticky, which is great. I took off a star cause it doesn't feel very moisturizing. In fact, after proper removal(oil cleanse then face wash), my skin felt dry when it normally doesn't. I'm shelving this until it's a little more humid out.

The Avène Mineral Sunscreen with SPF 50 is an excellent daily sunscreen that is water resistant, does not leave a white cast, feels pretty light and also protects agains the damaging blue light and since I spend all day in front of the computer, it seems like this sunscreen is ideal for me. It is scentless, feels like skincare and I love wearing it.

Avène is known for its gentle formulations, and this sunscreen is no exception. It's designed for sensitive skin, which is a major plus for those prone to irritation. The use of mineral filters (zinc oxide and titanium dioxide) is a key feature, as mineral sunscreens are often preferred by those with sensitive skin. The SPF 50+ rating provides excellent broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays. Beyond sun protection, it often contains antioxidants to help defend against environmental aggressors. The inclusion of Avène Thermal Spring Water is intended to soothe and calm the skin.

This sunscreen has a pleasantly liquid texture that allows for effortless application, ensuring an even spread across the skin without any heavy or greasy sensation. It absorbs quickly, leaving no overpowering scent or unsightly white cast behind. As someone with combination skin, I apply this sunscreen every morning before my makeup, and I've noticed it provides excellent oil control in my T-zone, minimizing shine throughout the day. I particularly appreciate that it boasts SPF 50, offering robust protection against UVA I, UVA II, UVB rays, and even visible blue light. This sunscreen has definitely earned its place in my daily skincare routine!

avis.titre: Makes protecting my skin a breeze!
avis.texte: I'm guilty of not always taking the best care of my skin, but this product makes it an easy and enjoyable experience. The consistency is perfect, and allows me to easily add it to my daily skincare routine.

Avene mineral sunscreen multi defence spf 50+ do not make my face oily nor leave any white cast on my skin. This sunscreen protects my screen from the blue from the gadgets.i will give only 4 stars as i had a few break outs after applying this .

This sunscreen is amazing! The SPF 50+ provides excellent protection for daily use, giving me peace of mind when I'm out and about. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, leaving no greasy or heavy feeling on my skin. Plus, it layers beautifully under makeup without pilling or affecting the finish. Definitely a staple in my skincare routine!

It gives my skin a beautiful dewy finish without feeling heavy or sticky. Plus, it wears really well under makeup—no pilling or patchiness. If you're looking for a sunscreen that feels fresh and light while still giving a nice glow, this one is definitely worth trying

I enjoyed trying Avene mineral sunscreen with SPF 50. It absorbed quickly and felt lightweight on my skin while leaving no white residue. I like that it protects against UVB, UVA, blue light, and pollution. It has the added benefit of ingredients like niacinamide and pro-vitamin E. I didn't notice any negative effects on my sensitive skin and it also helped even out skin tone. It's fragrance-free and non-comedogenic. The bottle is small but it's perfect for throwing in my purse.

avis.titre: Stood up to the FL sun!
avis.texte: Well this gets the FL approval! I was out all day and didn't get pink at all. It didn't have a scent and didn't sting which was a pleasant surprise. It soaked in very quickly. Perfect size to throw in my purse.
I'm loving this facial sunscreen! It's very easy to apply and doesn't leave any residue or greasy feeling . It's definitely waterproof and protects my skin for hours!

I love the ingredients of the sunscreen. It is lightweight and provides great coverage. I love the sun protection and the packaging is very cute. The scent is not very strong and it is comparable to many high-end brands. I would totally purchase this again.
